+"""Intent tests for risk.rolling_vol (M1-T17, RISK-02, TC-05)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk import Returns, VolSeries, rolling_vol
+
+
+def _returns(data: dict) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=data["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(data["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(data["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc05_rolling_vol_is_sample_stdev_of_earlier_returns(golden):
+    inp, expected = golden("risk", "TC-05")
+    returns = _returns(inp["returns"])
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, inp["window"])
+    assert isinstance(vol, VolSeries)
+    assert vol.returns == returns
+    assert vol.window == expected["window"]
+    assert vol.annualized is expected["annualized"]
+    assert set(vol.values) == set(expected["values"])
+    for ticker, want in expected["values"].items():
+        got = vol.values[ticker]
+        assert len(got) == len(returns.dates)
+        for g, w in zip(got, want, strict=True):
+            if w is None:
+                assert g is None
+            else:
+                assert g == pytest.approx(w, abs=expected["tol"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc05_no_value_until_window_earlier_returns_exist(golden):
+    inp, expected = golden("risk", "TC-05")
+    window = inp["window"]
+    vol = rolling_vol(_returns(inp["returns"]), window)
+    for ticker in expected["values"]:
+        assert vol.values[ticker][:window] == (None,) * window
+        assert all(v is not None for v in vol.values[ticker][window:])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_rolling_vol_never_uses_the_dates_own_return(golden):
+    inp, expected = golden("risk", "TC-05")
+    data = inp["returns"]
+    changed = dict(data["values"])
+    changed["X"] = [*data["values"]["X"][:-1], 10.0]
+    returns = _returns({**data, "values": changed})
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, inp["window"])
+    assert vol.values["X"][-1] == pytest.approx(expected["values"]["X"][-1], abs=expected["tol"])
+
